name: com.uee03.pretzel.parallax
description: Parallax scrolling for 2D and 2.5D: layers with a per-axis factor or a depth, infinite tiling, optional pixel snapping, and one controller that moves every layer in a single LateUpdate without allocations. Works with any camera, including Cinemachine. Needs no other Pretzel module.

samples.description: A side-scrolling backdrop with five layers: a 2D scene with an orthographic camera and a 2.5D scene with depth, both with infinitely tiling layers.
